ticker_news.title: After Warren Buffett's New $348 Billion Warning to Wall Street, Is He Worried About the Recent Stock Market Turmoil? The Answer May Surprise You.
ticker_news.description: Warren Buffett has been a net seller of stocks and has built up a record stockpile of cash at Berkshire Hathaway. Despite the recent stock market turmoil, Buffett is not worried and believes that investors should focus on the long-term and seize opportunities during difficult markets.
ticker_news.author: The Motley Fool

ticker_news.title: Qualcomm: Analyst Opinions Split, But Upside Potential Remains
ticker_news.description: Qualcomm's stock price has been volatile, with analysts divided on the company's long-term prospects. Some see significant upside potential, while others remain cautious due to concerns about China exposure and declining Apple-related revenue.
ticker_news.author: Marketbeat.Com
